summary: Validated backend and Expo web mobile preview for medicine packaging upload flows using public preview URL. Readable upload reached confirmation, unreadable image produced safe state, and replacement upload recovered successfully.

integration_issues.issue: Could not fully verify denied/blocked gallery permission + Open Settings branch in web preview because Platform.OS==='web' bypasses native media permission APIs.

action_items: Run one native-device regression for denied/blocked photo permission and Open Settings recovery paths on scan + unreadable screens.
Keep EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract aligned with frontend config lookup to avoid environment drift in future runs.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend SCAN_PROMPT explicitly enforces visible printed text extraction and prohibits loose tablet identification by appearance.
Image preprocessing path is implemented in both camera capture and gallery select with max width 1024 and JPEG compress 0.8.
frontend/services/gemini.ts still prefers EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL fallback chain; platform contract expects EXPO_BACKEND_URL/extra.EXPO_BACKEND_URL consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Readable packaging upload and unreadable->replacement recovery are passing on web preview. One automation false start occurred when using wrong upload entrypoint under camera permission modal; use camera-sheet-upload-button path in web runs.
rca_of_issue: RCA: Native media-permission denied/blocked flow cannot be deterministically exercised in Expo web because the implementation bypasses native permission requests on web (Platform.OS === 'web'). Mitigation: validate these branches on Android/iOS preview/dev build where ImagePicker permission APIs are active.
